messages:
Vik: Proposal: extend preflight to run a 'what-if' simulation. Client posts small sample vectors, preflight returns predicted fragments + estimated units + an alternate-cost table for different client batch sizes/quantization. Could stop a lot of surprise bills.

Lena: Nice. We already estimate fragments. Adding a cost delta table is doable if we map fragments->units->$ using current price table. Keep it advisory.

Omar: Ops concerns: simulation must be cheap. We should cap sample size (e.g., 20 example vectors) and run split heuristics without kernel-level ops. Also rate-limit preflight to 5/min/token.

Priya: Console UX: add a 'What if' slider on the Route page that adjusts client_batch_size and quantization knob and shows projected 24h cost change and p99 latency estimate. Helpful for customers tuning.

Vik: Telemetry: emit preflight.simulated_units with labels (route, tenant, batch_size_hint, quant_mode) and preflight.sim_confidence. We can compare simulated_units vs actual_units to measure accuracy.

Lena: Storage note: simulated_units will add a series per route-batch_size combo. Keep cardinality low by only storing top-traffic combinations and aggregating the rest as 'other'.

Omar: Rollout: 1) Launch preflight-whatif in beta for SDK users 2) Console shows read-only simulations 3) After 2 weeks enable interactive slider for beta tenants.

Priya: Edge cases: mixed-dim inputs and padded vectors. Preflight should return "uncertain" for items with unknown dims and recommend sending metadata (dim header) for accurate sim.

Vik: API sketch: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight { sample: [{id,x?}], batch_hints: {size:int, quant: "int8|fp16|none"} } -> {predicted_fragments:[], simulated_units:[], cost_table: [{batch_size, est_units, est_cost}], confidence}. Keep response small.

Lena: Add console metric 'preflight_accuracy' = 1 - |simulated_units - actual_units|/actual_units averaged per-tenant. If accuracy < 0.8 over 24h show a note recommending SDK metadata.

telemetry-bot: job/preflight-whatif-collector created (job-ops-20240607-04).

Omar: Action items: Vik write RFC + API spec, Lena estimate TSDB cost and sketch UI, Priya mock slider and copy. I'll add rate-limit + infra cap. We should ship beta next sprint.
